pages.title: The Skeleton Crown
pages.text: Found locked within the treasure vaults of $(5)End Cities$(0), the $(6)Skeleton Crown$(0) once bound the soul of an undying monarch.$(br2)It resonates with the marrow of fallen kings and holds the power to awaken the dread $(4)Skeleton King$(0).

pages.title: The Bone Altar
pages.text: 1. Assemble $(8)4 Bone Blocks$(0) into a vertical T-formation (1 base, 1 center, 2 lateral arms), matching the Wither altar.$(br)2. Right-click the center bone block with the $(6)Skeleton Crown$(0).$(br2)Soul fire detonates the structure, consuming the crown and raising the $(4)Skeleton King$(0).

pages.title: Perfume Catalysts
pages.text: Slaying the King yields $(d)perfume catalysts$(0) that awaken the $(6)Mighty Sword$(0):$(br2)• $(d)Cherche$(0): $(6)Shellbust Stab$(0)$(br)• $(e)Salty Rage$(0): $(6)Blastar Punch$(0)$(br)• $(5)Chantage$(0): $(6)Hellcry Punch$(0)$(br)• $(b)Setiemson$(0): $(6)Icewolf Bite$(0)$(br2)Transmute in the $(b)Transmutation Cube$(0)!
